query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-pinene' THEN 45.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Beta-pinene' THEN 20.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Delta-3-carene' THEN 15.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Limonene' THEN 8.0
  END,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-pinene' THEN 'Composant majeur, note résineuse'
    WHEN m.name = 'Beta-pinene' THEN 'Note fraîche de pin'
    WHEN m.name = 'Delta-3-carene' THEN 'Note douce résineuse'
    WHEN m.name = 'Limonene' THEN 'Note citronnée légère'
  END
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name = 'Pin sylvestre' 
AND m.name IN ('Alpha-pinene', 'Beta-pinene', 'Delta-3-carene', 'Limonene');
